text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Damn it all! Why couldn't I just hold on 
for one more step?!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
I was so close, damn it...! I'm so pissed 
at my own patheticness...!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
What kind of lukewarm talk is that! At 
this rate, you'll never measure up to 
being a truly great Umamusume!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
"Like hell I'm gonna let myself stumble in 
a place like this! If you got that, then 
hurry up and get ready for our review 
session!"

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
"I'm gonna go splash cold water on my face 
and fire myself back up!"

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Damn straight! I ain't ever wanna feel 
this miserable again!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
"Next time, Inari-sama will make a flower 
bloom! A huge one, to make up for today 
too!"

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Now that that's settled, I can't just sit 
around! Let's get back double-time!
